subject: Coordinating hands-on console + API session — timing options
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Rogers <emily.rogers@saasops.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.p@saasops.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Coordinating hands-on console + API session — timing options

Hi Emily, Rajiv —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier this week. We heard you wanted a short, hands-on session that covers both the Console (policy/config and observability) and a brief API walk-through focused on sandbox calls and token flows.

To make this practical for your engineers, Dev and I are proposing 90 minutes with an agenda (attached): console tour (30m), API sandbox + quick integration demo (40m), Q&A and next steps (20m).

Available slots (PST):
- Mon Nov 23: 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Tue Nov 24: 09:00–10:30
- Thu Nov 26: 11:00–12:30

If none of those work, tell us which day + windows work for your team and we’ll do our best to accommodate. I’ve CC’d Marissa to capture action items and follow-ups.

Attaching a draft agenda and sandbox instructions — bring any API keys you want us to test against your dev environment (or we can use a temporary token).

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: onboarding_agenda_v2.pdf (1.2MB), sandbox-access-instructions.txt

From: Emily Rogers <emily.rogers@saasops.com>

Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.p@saasops.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Coordinating hands-on console + API session — timing options

Karthik —

Thanks for the options and the agenda. That looks good. A few notes from our side:
- Prefer Tue Nov 24 09:00–10:30 PST if you can hold that; otherwise Mon Nov 23 14:00–15:30 PST.
- Our infra lead (Rajiv) will want the API portion to include a short demo of auth + token rotation and how to attach requests to a tenant id. Can Dev call that out?
- For the sandbox, we prefer Redwood to issue a temporary token rather than sharing our internal keys.

We’ll confirm the attendee list tomorrow but expect 4 people: myself, Rajiv, our frontend eng lead (Tina), and our platform eng (Diego).

Thanks — Emily
Emily Rogers
Head of Product Operations, SaaSOps Inc
emily.rogers@saasops.com | (415) 555-4120

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Coordinating hands-on console + API session — timing options

Emily —

Great — we can do Tue Nov 24 09:00–10:30 PST. I’ve updated the agenda to emphasize the auth/token rotation and tenant scoping; see the brief bullets below that I’ll demo:

- Generate a temporary sandbox token (server-side) and attach it to a simple curl request
- Demonstrate token rotation using our SDK (node/python snippets)
- Show how requests map to a tenant_id and where that appears in Console observability
- Walk through typical error patterns and quick debugging tips (KV cache and batch sizing notes)

I attached the updated agenda and a sandbox-howto (small text file) to this thread. We will NOT ask for any of your real keys — we’ll provision a short-lived token and send it to you before the session.

I’ll create a calendar invite and include a short Loom link with pre-recorded snippets for anyone who can’t attend live. Proposed invite: Tue Nov 24 09:00–10:30 PST — "Redwood: Console + API hands-on — SaaSOps".

If you need to shift to Mon, let me know and I’ll free up the slot.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai

Attachments: onboarding_agenda_v2.pdf (updated), sandbox-access-instructions.txt

From: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.p@saasops.com>

Dev, Karthik —

Thanks, that works for us. Please send the temporary sandbox token to rajiv.p@saasops.com and emily.rogers@saasops.com an hour before the session. I’ll share the calendar invite internally so Tina and Diego can join.

One quick ask: can you include a short slide (2–3 bullets) on best practices for production token rotation and monitoring? That will help our infra team prioritize changes after the session.

See you Tue.

— Rajiv
Platform Engineering Lead, SaaSOps Inc
rajiv.p@saasops.com | +1 650-555-0077
